Rows.doc:
The rows as they are written — settings screen, then config, then the
three defaults — before anything is derived.

Labels.doc:
The name on the button: a translation for the three built-in handles,
the author's own text for anything else — and never a raw key.

Queries.doc:
What a limit becomes in CSS: the media query in its own unit, the
inclusive px form `{{ responsive_css }}` writes, and the Tailwind prefix.

facade_doc_extra:
This class keeps the resolved list (cached per request) and everything
read from it; the parsing lives in `Breakpoints\Rows`, the button text in
`Breakpoints\Labels` and the CSS forms in `Breakpoints\Queries`. Split in
WP7d, code moved verbatim.
